summary_md: Reformatted a too-long assertion line in scripts/mobile-nav.pw.ts:83 to satisfy Biome's formatter, which was the 1 lint problem the previous attempt introduced. — researched from the venture's brain (semantic), planned as a PRP with 6 validation gate(s) (written), then passed on round 2 of 2 (earlier rounds failed — round 1: tests: your change introduced 1 lint problem(s) on the lines it wrote) against them plus tests, /review review pass (0 critical) and /qa: Booted backend (:3001) + Vite dev server headlessly and verified the mobile nav fix. All 3 tests in the ticket's own scripts/mobile-nav.pw.ts passed (hamburger menu visible and reaches all 12 destinations at 375px, hidden at desktop width, active tab auto-scrolls into view). Additional manual Playwright exploration at 375px confirmed: hamburger menu opens/closes correctly, outside-click dismisses it, opening the user menu closes the mobile menu (and vice versa) with no overlap, and the left/right scroll-fade affordances appear/disappear correctly as the tab bar is scrolled. Visually confirmed via screenshot that all 12 nav destinations are reachable and cleanly laid out in the dropdown. No bugs found..
